title: Snapshot
description: One message per sampling tick, pushed agent -> browser. Additive changes only within a major spec version.

seq.description: Increases by 1 per tick; a gap means dropped ticks.

intervalMs.description: Tick period, used by clients to detect a stalled feed.

collectors.description: One entry per collector. A failing collector reports ok=false and never blanks the others.

data.description: Collector-specific payload, typed per collector as each lands.
